ns2:section.sectionText: SP22 ENGL 481 This course will address teaching approaches about writing, including different theories and approaches to audience, purpose, and medium. Students will participate in small group discussions and hands-on activities. Weekly readings should be expected. The mid-term will be a reading synthesis while the final will be either a potential teaching portfolio or research project.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to English or Rhetoric or Creative Writing major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
